posts.title: AIDRAD: Why Early Validation Eliminates Late-Stage Rework
posts.description: In traditional enterprise software delivery, finding an architectural mismatch during UAT carries a 10x-50x rework penalty. In this AIDRAD deep dive, we show how continuous automated invariant validation locks in business intent and data contracts before backend code is written.

posts.title: How I Migrated My Aging WordPress Blog with AI Agents – and Kept Control of the Decisions
posts.description: An outdated PHP warning became a clean WordPress rebuild. Here is how AI agents handled the technical work, where I retained control, and what the migration taught me.

posts.title: AIDRAD: Why Demo-Driven Validation Beats Document-Driven Approval
posts.description: For decades, enterprise IT relied on ceremonial sign-offs on 100-page Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)—a ritual that produced rubber-stamped approvals and catastrophic reality shocks six months later. In this AIDRAD essay, we examine why interactive, Day-3 working prototypes replace speculative documentation with empirical truth.
